notes: Names printed TOWNSHIP and RAWSON (no suffix) are written with 'Street'. Township jogs at Garrard: the 40 ft piece labelled TOWNSHIP here (faces y~900/1141) comes from the west and ends at Garrard's west line; the street leaving Garrard's east side ~75 ft further south (faces y~1378/1612, 4 in. water pipe, unlabelled here) is the main Township Street of sheets 273/274/281/282, so the short west piece is named 'Township Street (west of Garrard)'. NOTE: sheets 301/302 use the opposite convention ('Township Street' for this west piece and 'Township Street (east of Garrard)' for the main street), so ties at Garrard and Rawson need reconciling. Township passes under the railroad through the 'stone arched driveway under R.R.' (x~1100-1600) and runs off the left edge at the binding (x~120), where its north line flares away to the NW; no end recorded. Rawson (40 ft) comes in from the north only (south side of Township is one property), so T. Garrard runs down the right edge: west line x~5805-5812, east line x~6085 north of y~4419 (45 ft printed) and x~6180-6188 south of it (60 ft printed). Marshall (60 ft, faces y~6704/7060) starts at the railroad and crosses Garrard (Garrard continues south onto 253). The long lines at x~4500 and y~4300 are property lines, not streets. Circled figures are grade elevations. Railroad tracks and Mill Creek ignored.
